verdict.rationale: Insomnia supports mock servers, environments, and Cloud/Git Sync that allow separating test/dev environments from production credentials and endpoints, which can approximate a sandbox workflow, but there is no explicit 'sandbox environment' feature or AI-native isolation guarantee, and no evidence describes automatic prevention of touching production data. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/staging isolation feature, documented safeguards against hitting production endpoints, AI-agent-specific sandbox testing workflow, independent verification of these use cases.
